column1: # vk_android_build.py: tool changes whose Android shader libraries are byte-identical to an earlier version's (vk_android_build.py vk_version, android/SHADERS.md#versions).
# A row is added only after a full build with the new tools reproduced the earlier library byte for byte; its digest is then that library's version.

column3: result cache, progress lines, ctypes seam (35331832 on e38a586a8a89): full DKB build 2026-11-03, dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical

the translator library checked by its source tree (xlate_tree.py), one translator call at a time for the library form (DMSH_VK_XLATE_J), the validator version in the result stamp, no result without a module or a reason, DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL: full DKB build 2026-11-03 with the library forms (ctypes), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical
stamp rows in the delta manifest (vk_android_delta.py stamp_only, restamped_header; --publish-delta writes them): full DKB and MKW 1.8.0 builds 2026-11-04, dmsh_vk.lib byte-identical

DMSH_VK_REQUIRE_ALL takes the profile manifest's "-" shaders (not built in the Mac's full build) out of the failures, and the delta check takes such a shader not built as the manifest has it (vk_android_delta.py not_built_there, entry_as_manifest): full MKW 1.8.0 build 2026-11-05 with REQUIRE_ALL, dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical

gmem_cache pass kept but off (GMEM_CACHE False: v-0da35c39552a measured slower on the phone, fb11 +14 % per vertex invocation), the gmem_loop function range re-read, index.json gmem_cache field only with GMEM_CACHE on: full OoT build 2026-11-08, dmsh_vk.lib and index.json byte-identical but for vk_chain, _vk_build.json byte-identical

subinterpreter workers (DMSH_VK_INTERPS, the phone), the library and index.json written as the results are read (issue 13: 4.1 -> 1.2 GB at the end), the result heads kept slim: full Ocarina of Time build 2026-11-14 in the phone form (translator and validator as libraries, 6 subinterpreters), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical to v-0dd4341ae6ce

subinterpreter workers fall back to the threads with one line where none can be set up, the translator gate a pipe (no polling), workers closed one by one, a cut-short result found before the library is written: full Ocarina of Time build 2026-11-14 in the phone form (translator and validator as libraries, 6 subinterpreters), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical to v-0dd4341ae6ce

a worker set up on demand goes straight to the batch that made it, not through the idle queue another thread could take it from: full Ocarina of Time build 2026-11-14 in the phone form (translator and validator as libraries, 6 subinterpreters), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json and _vk_build.json byte-identical to v-0dd4341ae6ce

the SPIR-V passes made cheaper per shader (each source module parsed once and copied, not re-parsed; one decoration lookup per placement; opcodes listed once per pass; local_forward and ssbo_base skip what cannot match; the facts and driver-read rows looked up before the loop): full Ocarina of Time build 2026-11-14 in the phone form (translator and validator as libraries, 6 subinterpreters), dmsh_vk.lib, index.json, _vk_build.json, vk_delta.tsv and inputs.tsv byte-identical to v-0dd4341ae6ce
